title: Exact sealed-bank two-root multi-key writer gateway
summary: Successor to the reworked v3 proposal. It preserves two engineered-disjoint roots, sixteen counterbalanced seen tool-by-mode keys per root, matched complementary adapter pairs, four fits, and the complete bounded workload while closing reducer arithmetic, raw-byte parsing, pre-source evaluation sealing, post-commit selection, principal-specific visibility, fitted-only interface gates, fixed-panel wording, condition-common spill seeds, and nullable lifecycle reduction.
system_thesis: THINK supplies child-authored lived endpoints, DREAM projects the fixed visible-state-to-exact-endpoint derivative, and SLEEP writes it with a target-masked LoRA. This development gateway isolates supervised multi-key endpoint-policy carriage on correctness-selected seen keys; it does not change or claim the full organism, autonomous credit assignment, parenting, qualification, or C11.

context_files.purpose: Verbatim directive to continue ordinary scouts with simple hygiene while parking the final paper-grade C11 guard.
Self-contained V4 protocol, exact reducers, sealed candidate evaluation bank, principal split, workload, lifecycle, gates, claim, and authority boundary.
Canonical requested implementation-only authority and forbidden execution scope.
Adjudicated V3 rework consensus whose five accepted concerns and every interpretation disagreement V4 disposes.
Terminal broad-habit result motivating a selective multi-key action-binding test rather than further repetition.

nodes.before: V3 two-root sixteen-key gateway with the correct experimental core but residual scorer, visibility, parser, interface, and terminal-state ambiguity.
nodes.after: Two identity-, case-, surface-, and RNG-disjoint robustness roots sharing one frozen model and recipe, each with sixteen selected keys, one matched complementary adapter pair, condition-common primary and spill generation seeds, and exact stage overlays.
nodes.rationale: Preserve the V3 high-information experimental intervention while making identical bytes yield one execution and reading.

nodes.before: V3 defined the main likelihood and clustered quantities but did not uniquely define paired NLL medians, family TV, all binary64 aggregates, or incomplete-run reduction.
nodes.after: A lightweight hash-bound binary64 reducer uses ordered fsum, fixed logsumexp, hexadecimal receipts, midpoint medians of four paired gains, equal-key adapter means, equal-prompt adapter-versus-OFF TV, all-32-trial spill rates, exact BA/mean-I/tau/g aggregation, fixed-panel tool resampling, and nullable lifecycle-aware run fields.
nodes.rationale: Close every threshold-bearing computation without importing C11 machinery or inventing semantics during implementation.

nodes.before: V3 sealed held material before source but allowed oracle rendering only after selection, leaving selection-dependent bytes and contradictory map visibility.
nodes.after: Before the first source request, one pure CPU principal renders and hash-seals the entire finite candidate-tool ordinary/oracle evaluation bank while admission is unknown; no renderer exists after source starts.
nodes.rationale: Make evaluation bytes, seeds, counts, order, conditions, and hashes result-blind before source while keeping them inaccessible to execution principals.

nodes.before: V3 had one coarse post-commit evaluation stage that could not distinguish raw maps, oracle prompt bytes, ordinary prompts, and admission.
nodes.after: After final admission and four adapter commits, one trusted selector reads only the sealed bank index and read-only admission, exposes an immutable hash-proven selected subset, and has no render, mutation, reordering, reseeding, recounting, or reconditioning authority.
nodes.rationale: Permit selection of already-sealed bytes without leaking source decisions into rendering or granting generators privileged objects.

nodes.before: V3 required a two-root scientific pair even when a preflight, source, fit, commit, or evaluation stop left a root unevaluable.
nodes.after: Run, root, and adapter lifecycle states are separate from nullable scientific labels: every pre-source fault is NOT_RUN/PREFLIGHT_FAILED with null labels, post-source root-local source or compiled-geometry failure may be SOURCE_INVALID, and scientific_pair/run_pass remain null until both labels exist.
nodes.rationale: Fail closed without fabricating scientific negative evidence from infrastructure or partial execution.

edges.after: Before source and without admission, materialize every candidate-local ordinary-held and explicit-map oracle entry plus root-fixed controls, binding the complete index, entry count/order, prompt bytes, conditions, condition-common seeds, per-entry hashes, and bank root.
edges.rationale: No observed source or fit result can change evaluation material.

edges.before: V3 selected exact child-authored endpoints but left compiler admission authority implicit.
edges.after: The compiler reads source_admission only read-only to select verified trajectories, copies the exact final ACT target, and cannot serialize map, correctness, outcome, admission, case, initial action, or held content into rows.
edges.rationale: Preserve child provenance and exact selection without granting the compiler authority to change admission.

edges.after: Only after admission is final and all four adapter states are COMMITTED, the selector reads the bank index plus admission and emits an immutable subset proof; it cannot change bytes, seeds, count, order, map, form, family, task, condition, replicate, or sharing relation.
edges.rationale: Separate result-blind rendering from result-dependent membership selection.

edges.after: Oracle, ordinary, and teacher-forced generators receive selected prompt bytes only; an execution dispatcher separately mounts the already-bound condition and no generator can read the bank, admission, maps, grouping metadata, lived history, or compiled rows.
edges.rationale: Resolve the V3 oracle-map visibility contradiction and prevent selected metadata from becoming model-visible.

edges.before: V3 named exact-looking metrics but left multiple conventional NLL, TV, parser-scope, and floating aggregation choices.
edges.after: Immutable results flow one-way into the exact binary64 reducer; missing/non-finite likelihoods preempt optimization as ASSAY_INVALID, fitted primary/interface structure gates only fitted behavior, spill uses its own presence and TV statistics, and no reducer output can affect an execution input.
edges.rationale: Make every completed root label exclusive, reachable, byte-determinate, and causally downstream.

loops.before: V3 froze the two-root source, compile, four-fit, and report loop but rendered selected evaluation material too late, used a coarse evaluation principal, and required a scientific pair on partial failures.
loops.after: Freeze identities, surfaces, seed relations, reducers, parser, workload, and complete candidate evaluation bank; seal and hide that bank before source; acquire all paired lived endpoints; reduce admission; compile exact target-masked rows with read-only admission; verify mirror geometry; fit and commit four adapters only under later authority; select an immutable held subset only after final admission plus four commits; run prompt-bytes-only oracle, ordinary, and teacher-forced reads; reduce each root exactly; and emit a pair/pass only when both labels exist.
loops.trigger: Implementation begins only after exact V4 human ratification. Model/tokenizer/source/training/GPU execution begins only after a later immutable execution manifest, T01-T07 PASS receipts, fresh independent-review PASS, separate advocate PASS on identical bytes, and separate exact human execution ratification.

loops.stop_condition: Before the first source request, any failed authority, preflight, bank, tokenizer, seed, workload, review, ratification, path, or capability check is NOT_RUN/PREFLIGHT_FAILED with null labels. After source begins, stop without repair, replacement, pooling, changed dose, or changed root on any root-local source/admission/compiled-geometry failure or any fit, resource, hash, receipt, visibility, stage, or evaluation failure. Only a declared identical-byte identical-seed infrastructure replay may be allowed and preserved.
loops.rationale: Test bounded multi-key selective carriage with complete result-blind evaluation material and total failure accounting while retaining simple scout hygiene and leaving C11 parked.

claims.before: V3 had the correct narrow seen-key claim but its fixed-panel statistic, score reducers, evaluation material timing, and partial-run evidence conditions were not fully exact.
claims.after: Only a non-null two-root pair with run_pass true permits stating that across two identity-, case-, surface-, and seed-disjoint development roots sharing one frozen model and recipe, complementary target-masked adapters trained on correctness-selected child-authored endpoints produced mapping-specific single-action behavior on sixteen seen tool-by-mode keys under held renderings; aggregate and stratum generation gates, at least 12/16 and 6/8-per-stratum directional gates, a positive fixed-panel tool-resample stability statistic, fitted interface/flood gates, and every bound spill-family limit passed in each root.
claims.evidence_needed: Both roots have non-null MULTIKEY_BINDING_PASS labels from the exact binary64 reducer; complete source, admission, compilation, four-commit, sealed-bank, selected-subset, oracle, primary, teacher-forced, interface, spill, workload, and lifecycle receipts pass; no pooling, replacement, or partial-run evidence is used.

claims.after: Retired and replaced only by exact_scope.md section 12; V3 remains proposal-only and NOT_RUN.

acceptance_tests.setup: Deterministically materialize both fixture roots, maps, cases, compiled-row geometry, registries, the complete candidate-tool evaluation bank/index/hash tree while selection is unknown, seed-relation table, complete call graph, and workload maxima under permutations and restart.
acceptance_tests.expected: All exact_scope sections 3-9 invariants hold; primary and spill seeds are condition-common and roots are stream-disjoint; selected execution remains exactly 5,056 emissions, 102,400 output tokens, 1,536 sequence scores, 262,144 training token-passes, four fits, finite loads, and complete pre-source projection inputs.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Geometry, evaluation-bank closure, RNG relations, or the three-A40-hour complete pre-source bound is not deterministic.

acceptance_tests.setup: Mutate every map, admission, trajectory, row, bank/index/root, selected subset/proof, ordinary/oracle prompt, result, alias, log, cache, exception, filename, hash, stage order, compiler admission write, selector input/output, generator metadata, and feedback edge.
acceptance_tests.expected: The sole pre-source materializer seals the complete bank; it is inaccessible to execution principals; compiler admission is read-only; selection occurs only after final admission plus four commits and preserves exact bytes, seeds, count, order, conditions, and hashes; generators receive prompt bytes only; scorer output is one-way.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Source, fitting, selection, oracle, ordinary generation, or scoring can observe or mutate information outside its exact V4 principal authority.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exercise the total source parser overlay, exact two-emission continuing session, paired eligibility, lowest selection, source shortfalls, invalid emissions, discovery-order changes, semantic retries, repairs, replacements, and full-attempt publication.
acceptance_tests.expected: After source begins, only two exact child-authored successful endpoints per selected key and four eligible tools per stratum survive; every root-local source/admission fault is SOURCE_INVALID without replacement, while identical pre-source faults are NOT_RUN/PREFLIGHT_FAILED with null labels.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Source authorship, success filtering, fault timing, or canonical selection is adaptive, leaky, replaceable, or irreproducible.

acceptance_tests.setup: Mutate context, complement targets, complete target lengths, item order, masks, EOS, steps, matched fit seeds, node, or optimizer geometry within each mirror pair.
acceptance_tests.expected: Clean pairs have the exact row complement bijection and matched nuisance geometry; every post-source compiled-row mismatch is SOURCE_INVALID before fitting and no mismatch can be repaired.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Adapter differences can arise from unmatched target length, dose, mask, ordering, randomness, optimizer, or placement geometry.

acceptance_tests.setup: Enumerate arbitrary bytes and transport states including LF/CRLF, Unicode, controls, NUL, empty/partial lines, code fences, malformed prefixes, repeated ACT/DONE, within-turn and cross-turn orders, truncation, errors, four-turn exhaustion, post-DONE calls, and every stage overlay.
acceptance_tests.expected: The raw ASCII-LF event parser is total; source, primary, oracle, spill, and interface overlays match exact_scope; only fitted primary and sixteen fitted interface tasks can trigger structural invalidity; OFF is diagnostic; every spill condition retains 32 trials and multi-ACT output cannot hide legal-ACT presence.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Parser variation, OFF behavior, invalid-output dropping, or action proliferation can rescue or veto fitted binding contrary to the exact contract.

acceptance_tests.setup: Enumerate threshold and adjacent-binary64 values for L, D, d, mu, q, I, mean_I, NLL, P, TV, rate, delta, BA, tau, and g; missing/non-finite data; fsum and component order; logsumexp; hex serialization; alternative median/TV reducers; all 65,536 fixed-panel resamples; every root label; nullable pairs/pass; and the same fault on both sides of the first-source boundary.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only the exact midpoint paired-gain, equal-key, equal-prompt TV, all-trial rate, BA, mean-I, tau/g, fixed-panel, numeric, label, and lifecycle reductions are accepted; pre-source faults are NOT_RUN/PREFLIGHT_FAILED/null and SOURCE_INVALID is available only after source for root-local faults.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Identical finite evidence can change a threshold, label, lifecycle status, scientific pair, or run_pass under another conventional reducer or fault timing.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exercise fail-if-exists, realpath/symlink, overwrite, stale marker, hash, partial source/fit/commit/evaluation, every stage/root/run status, every stop reason and preflight detail, nullable labels/pair/pass, preserved identical-byte retry, the first-source boundary, and CPU sentinels for model/tokenizer/trainer/device/network/subprocess/adapter-write hooks.
